faq.q1Question: What do I need to start?
faq.q1Answer: Your invitation, the date and place, and your guest names. Nothing else.
faq.q2Question: Does my guest need an app or an account?
faq.q2Answer: No. The invitation arrives on WhatsApp and they reply with one tap, or they open the link and enter their name.
faq.q3Question: What is the difference between the two options?
faq.q3Answer: Digital: one invitation per guest, by name, sent by you. Link: one link you post, and whoever opens it registers themselves.
faq.q4Question: How do I manage entry at the door?
faq.q4Answer: Everyone who accepts receives a pass with a code. Copy the scanner link from the event page and send it to your door staff — they scan from their own phone, with no login.
faq.q5Question: What happens to my guests’ data?
faq.q5Answer: It stays yours, and is never shared. You can ask for it to be deleted at any time.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Mahalli. The platform is currently in a trial phase — by using it, you agree to the terms below.
terms.section1Body: Mahalli serves two kinds of users: organizers (who create an account to manage their events) and guests (who use an invitation link to respond, with no account needed). These terms apply to both, as relevant to how they use the platform.
terms.section2Body: You're responsible for the accuracy of your event and guest data, and for keeping your account credentials secure. Don't use the platform to send abusive or unlawful content, or to collect guest data without their knowledge.
terms.section3Body: The platform is currently in a trial phase: some channels (like WhatsApp or email notifications) may not always be actively enabled, and we're continuously improving stability and features. We don't guarantee uninterrupted or error-free service, and we make a reasonable effort to fix any issue once found.
terms.section4Body: Your invitation's content (text, images, an organization logo if applicable) remains yours. By sharing it through the platform, you grant us only the permission needed to display, store, and send it to your guests per your own settings.
terms.section5Body: We may update these terms or the platform's features as we continue building it, and we'll aim to notify you of any material change. Any account used in violation of these terms may be suspended.
terms.section6Body: For any question about these terms, reach us at support@mhalli.co.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Here's what data we collect, how we use it, and who can access it — in the simplest terms possible.
privacy.section1Body: From organizers: name, phone number or email (for sign-in), and the event data they create. From guests: name and phone number (when responding to an invitation), and their answers to any custom questions the organizer added.
privacy.section2Body: We use your data only to run the service: displaying the invitation, recording guest responses, sending confirmations and reminders (via WhatsApp or email once enabled), and showing response stats to the organizer. We never sell your data or use it for advertising.
privacy.section3Body: A given event's guest data is visible only to that specific event's organizer — enforced at the database level itself (Row Level Security), not just in the interface. No other organizer can see events or guests that aren't theirs.
privacy.section4Body: When an organizer enables WhatsApp or email sending, the confirmation message is sent through the relevant provider (Meta WhatsApp Cloud API, or Resend for email) — only the data needed to deliver that message (the phone number or email, and the message text) is shared with them. We never share your data with anyone else.
privacy.section5Body: Data is stored in Supabase (a secure PostgreSQL-based infrastructure), protected by row-level access policies. No full-privilege admin key is ever used from inside the browser.
privacy.section6Heading: 6. Where your data is stored and cross-border transfer
privacy.section6Body: Our database servers and the providers we rely on (site hosting, WhatsApp, email) are located outside Saudi Arabia. This means your data is processed and stored on foreign servers, under contractual safeguards with those providers that preserve the same level of protection.
privacy.section7Heading: 7. Your rights under Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law
privacy.section7Body: You have the right to access your data, correct it, request its deletion, withdraw your consent, or request a copy of it. Any guest can edit or delete their response via their own private link at any time before the deadline. To exercise any of these rights, or to request full deletion of your data from any event, reach us at support@mhalli.co and we'll respond within a reasonable time. You also have the right to file a complaint with the Saudi Data & AI Authority (SDAIA) if you're not satisfied with how we handled your request.
